name: @hyperbridge/simplex-desktop
description: Native desktop shell for the Simplex intent solver
author: Polytope Labs <hello@polytope.technology>

scripts.package: pnpm run ensure:electron && pnpm run stage:solver && node scripts/run-builder.mjs --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:integration
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run ensure:electron && node scripts/e2e/assert-artifacts.mjs && tsx --tsconfig ../simplex/tsconfig.json --test --test-timeout=300000 scripts/e2e/desktop.e2e.mjs
scripts.test:unit: vitest --watch=false src/tests/blackhole-server.test.ts src/tests/desktop-paths.test.ts src/tests/daemon.test.ts src/tests/desktop-security.test.ts src/tests/electron-launch.test.ts src/tests/login-item.test.ts src/tests/notification-client.test.ts src/tests/release-provider.test.ts src/tests/solver-supervisor.test.ts src/tests/tray-icon.test.ts src/tests/tray-menu.test.ts src/tests/update-authenticity.test.ts src/tests/update-coordinator.test.ts src/tests/update-store.test.ts scripts/ensure-electron.test.ts scripts/package-release.test.ts scripts/release-signing.test.ts scripts/stage-node.test.ts scripts/stage-solver.test.ts scripts/workspace-policy.test.ts
